children: said on Monday its IT arm will acquire a 22.1% stake in Happiest Minds Technologies
for about 13.3 billion rupees ($139.76 million) in cash, as part of a merger with the IT services provider.
The deal, which will take three to eight months to complete, comes as mid-sized Indian IT firms race to bulk up their capabilities through big-ticket buyouts amid AI-related disruptions.
The combined entity will have a workforce of over 19,000 employees, ITC said in an exchange filing. Shares of ITC Infotech are set to list on the BSE
and the National Stock Exchange after the deal.
